answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Dial painter escapement trial stamped by the chronometer office flips the bet — each escapement is a serial number etched beside the makers mark, so a farm must paint a hundred real dials by hand — and the umber lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the ocean of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The summit is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
